features.title: Manage local and remote MCP server definitions
features.summary: Create, edit, enable, connect, disconnect, refresh, and remove bounded stdio or Streamable HTTP server definitions while keeping credentials as references.

configuration.constraints: Native Loader Config list with at most 64 server definitions.
At most 32 environment-variable-to-credential-reference pairs; inline credentials in argv are rejected.
HTTPS URL without embedded username/password, query, or fragment.
Declared preference is currently not user-writable; Host uses the hard-coded parsed default.
Declared integer preference 5 to 600 seconds; currently not user-writable.
Declared boolean preference currently not user-writable.
Declared trimmed text from 1 to 120 characters; currently not user-writable.

failureModes: Malformed URL, inline credential, duplicate tool namespace, or invalid server identifier is rejected.
Client-loaded status never claims a native server health ping was performed.

externalDependencies.boundary: Native MCP client, local stdio process, and remote Streamable HTTP endpoint.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use an in-process local MCP server and injected fake subprocess; do not connect to customer endpoints.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the server-validation scenario of "Manage local and remote MCP server definitions"; nothing automated verifies it yet.
No browser journey exists yet for the lifecycle scenario of "Manage local and remote MCP server definitions"; nothing automated verifies it yet.
No browser journey exists yet for the settings-boundary scenario of "Manage local and remote MCP server definitions"; nothing automated verifies it yet.

features.title: Search curated providers and the MCP Registry
features.summary: Browse curated provider documentation and search the official Registry while handling unavailable or malformed catalog responses safely.
failureModes: Registry failure or oversized response is shown without adding a server.
Only safe HTTPS catalog endpoints are requested.

externalDependencies.boundary: Official MCP Registry HTTP search endpoint.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Intercept the registry request and return fixed success, empty, malformed, and failure fixtures; no public network.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the registry-search scenario of "Search curated providers and the MCP Registry"; nothing automated verifies it yet.

features.title: Authorize remote OAuth servers
features.summary: Discover OAuth metadata, register a client, run PKCE/state validation, exchange and refresh grants, and clear grant state on sign-out.
failureModes: Issuer mismatch, invalid state, expired callback, or token refresh failure never yields a signed-in state.

externalDependencies.boundary: Remote OAuth discovery, authorization, token exchange, and refresh HTTP endpoints.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a fake fetcher and synthetic issuer metadata/tokens; never use real OAuth cookies, browser profiles, or credentials.

verification.reason: No browser journey exists yet for the oauth-lifecycle scenario of "Authorize remote OAuth servers"; only the unit tests listed for this feature verify it.

honours the resource_metadata hint from a 401 challenge

exchanges the code with the verifier and records expiry
